# PhantomRank

> AI Search Intelligence built for brands and marketing agencies. Monitor your brand visibility, citations, and share of voice in real-time across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and Copilot.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.phantomrank.com/): AI Search Intelligence built for brands and marketing agencies.
- [Pricing](https://www.phantomrank.com/pricing): Simple, transparent pricing plans built for brands and boutique agencies.
- [Use Cases](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases): Industry-specific playbooks for tracking and optimizing AI search visibility.
- [Learn Hub](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn): In-depth guides and articles about Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Sign Up](https://www.phantomrank.com/signup): Request access to start tracking your brand's AI search engine visibility.

## Selected Playbooks

- [SaaS & Software Playbook](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases/saas-software): Playbook for SaaS brands to monitor AI recommendations and feature citations.
- [Ecommerce & Retail Playbook](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases/ecommerce-retail): Track and optimize product citations and brand recommendations.
- [Fintech & Banking Playbook](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases/fintech-banking): Build and track visibility for financial institutions in AI assistant outputs.
- [Healthcare & Pharma Playbook](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases/healthcare-pharma): Playbook for healthcare brands to ensure accuracy and presence in AI-generated answers.
- [Real Estate Playbook](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases/real-estate): Monitor real estate brand citations and geographical recommendations across AI engines.
